answer.summary: The API types check failed because the generated front-end types file (api-types.d.ts) is out of date with the Java API changes in this PR. The diff moves the inject_execution_threshold_minutes fields, and the check exits with 'Forgot to generate types'. Re-running will fail the same way until the developer runs 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' and commits the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
